is_anopheles.evidence: The study examined field-collected Anopheles mosquitoes, predominantly Anopheles arabiensis, Anopheles gambiae S form, and Anopheles gambiae M form in the Senegal River basin (p. 1, 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping of the Vgsc L1014F kdr mutation (L995F) in Anopheles gambiae s.l. specimens by PCR (p. 3, 5, 6).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Genotype counts (15 homozygote mutant L1014F, 122 heterozygotes, 762 homozygote wild-type out of 899 specimens) and species-specific allele frequencies (An. arabiensis: 103/1486 alleles, An. gambiae M: 3/60 alleles, An. gambiae S: 46/252 alleles) are explicitly provided in text (p. 6) and Table 1 (p. 5).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from 20 villages in the middle Senegal River basin, Senegal, between September 2008 and January 2010 using HLC and PSC (p. 2-3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary field entomological study measuring Anopheles density, biting rates, Plasmodium infection, and kdr frequencies (p. 1-3).

sub_country_location.evidence: Specific village names are provided (e.g. Agnam Towguel, Fanay Dierry, Guédé Village, Ndiayene Pendao, Niandane, etc.) and GPS coordinates were recorded (p. 2-3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Sampling took place from September 2008 to January 2010, spanning a 16-month period (p. 3-4).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Primary field collection conducted under the Pal-Fleuve / Ano-Pal-AnoVac project without indication of dataset overlap with existing repository consortia.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype frequencies, sample numbers, and site details are contained within the main text and Table 1.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated Anopheles vector diversity and malaria transmission dynamics across 20 villages in the middle Senegal River basin, Senegal, from September 2008 to January 2010. A total of 899 An. gambiae s.l. specimens (743 An. arabiensis, 126 An. gambiae S form, and 30 An. gambiae M form) were genotyped for the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) kdr mutation, revealing 15 RR, 122 RS, and 762 SS genotypes.
